entrypoints.description: Typed handoff checkpoint owns bounded current horizon/cursor reconstruction.
Fresh-Agent v3 report contract validates staged cue integrity, report semantics and controller-owned cue digests.

extension_seams: Add compact required bootstrap references when a new permanent governance mechanism must survive every handoff.
Add resume-relevant asset transport metadata without turning the handoff into a historical asset ledger.
Improve on-demand routing into cold Git/Issue/receipt history without preloading or duplicating that history into the handoff.
Tighten Fresh-Agent drill transport/report validation when a real rehearsal exposes a harness ambiguity, without weakening fresh-session isolation or turning the controller into the subject.

guards.description: Handoff tests enforce bounded bootstrap and live-head delta semantics.
Fresh-Agent v3 rejects contentless trigger words as completed external cue payloads.
Controller contract owns externally staged cue payloads and maintainer acceptance criteria; subject protocol never receives future payload text early.
Subject contract distinguishes pre-delivery secrecy from the requirement to read and answer a valid delivered cue.
Cold project history is retrieved on demand through owner/invariant/origin routing instead of becoming default context.
Every fresh Agent receives the bounded historical-recall trigger without preloading old history.

non_goals: Maintaining a second continuously rewritten summary of all project history.
Transporting live PostgreSQL as session authority.
Treating a same-session self-test as a genuine external Fresh-Agent pass.
Using hidden trigger words as substitutes for externally delivered drill questions.
purpose: Own bounded fresh-agent recovery of mission/current horizon/live cursor plus resume-relevant binary identity, route into cold project history only when a relevant cue appears, and validate genuine staged Fresh-Agent continuity drills without allowing contentless cue triggers or same-session self-certification; live Git/CI and original repository history remain authority.
revisit_when: Only replace if a stronger continuity authority preserves bounded cold-start recovery, live-ref freshness, explicit asset integrity, selective historical recall, genuine external-stage isolation, delivered-cue integrity and report-only provenance without requiring user restatement or preloading project history.
title: Repository-backed session continuity and data-plane handoff
